summary: Full E2E testing of DocLive (FastAPI+React+MongoDB). 13/13 backend pytest tests passed (facets, doctors list + all filters, doctor detail 404/200, appointment create/conflict/cancel, consultations, profile get/update). Frontend Playwright happy path passed: home hero + searchbar, navigation to /recherche, filtering (Dermatologie -> 1 card, Téléconsultation -> 6 cards), 3-step booking modal creating a CONFIRMED appointment, doctor profile modal, appointments cancellation, followup timeline (3 consultations), profile save with confirmation message.
critical_code_review_comments: seed() only inserts when collections are empty; if seed data changes later it won't refresh existing DBs — acceptable for MVP but should be documented.
GET /api/appointments returns cancelled/past in 'history' via list-difference (a not in upcoming) which is O(n^2); minor perf, fine for demo scale.
CORS allow_origins uses env split by comma; middleware is added AFTER include_router — works with FastAPI but conventional ordering is before router include.
test_credentials: None (demo patient hardcoded server-side as 'demo-patient' / Maria Gonzalez).
seed_data_creation: None (backend auto-seeds 8 doctors, 3 consultations, 1 profile on startup). Test created one appointment then cancelled it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows validated. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_doclive_api.py is idempotent (picks any available slot, cancels created appointment). Frontend testids present throughout (search-*, filter-*, doctor-card-*, slot-btn-*, booking-*, confirm-appointment-button, booking-confirmation, cancel-appointment-*, consultation-*, profile-*).
